rationale: The change alters the interface supplying obstacle information to the operational representation, specifically the source of obstacle presence. In the baseline, H1-ORR1 depends on H1-A1 and H1-RC1, which require that the obstacle-information basis continues to support distinguishing collision-relevant obstacle presence from absence. The evaluation target, phenomenon of interest, and other concern-relevant distinctions remain unchanged, so only the obstacle-presence ORR must be revalidated.
